semiconductor_relevance: High — Hanbell Vacuum Technology specializes in dry vacuum pumps essential for maintaining high-quality vacuum environments in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hanbell Vacuum Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures dry vacuum pumps that are critical for achieving high-quality vacuum conditions in semiconductor fabrication. Their products, particularly the PS and PMF series, are designed to optimize performance while reducing operational costs, making them suitable for various semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Global: Hanbell operates 13 service factories worldwide, ensuring support and maintenance for their vacuum systems.
